input: Source a local frame shop for the kids' artwork

gold.taskTitle: Source a local frame shop for kids' artwork
gold.taskDescription: Find and select a suitable local frame shop to frame the children's artwork.

questions.title: How many pieces of artwork need to be framed?
questions.description: Understand the volume of artwork to determine scope and cost.

questions.title: What are the approximate sizes of the artwork pieces?
questions.description: Know the dimensions to identify shops that can handle the required frame sizes.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this framing project?
questions.description: Establish a budget to filter shops by pricing appropriateness.

questions.title: Do you want custom framing or standard off-the-shelf frames?
questions.description: Determine whether a full-service custom framer or a retail frame shop is needed.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the shop be located in?
questions.description: Define the geographic area to narrow down the local search.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which the framing must be completed?
questions.description: Identify any time constraints that would affect which shops are viable.

questions.title: Are there specific frame styles or materials you prefer?
questions.description: Capture aesthetic preferences such as wood, metal, color, or matting choices.
